name: Richest Country Guides
tagline: Practical how-to guides for indie developers shipping small web products.
description: Step-by-step guides for building waitlists, status pages, donation leaderboards, and other small web tools. Written from real starter kits, with working code.
author: Richest Country

discounts.label: 50% off

leaderboard.name: Leaderboard Starter Kit
leaderboard.blurb: A Stripe-powered donation leaderboard with weekly resets, a hall of fame, and a free tap game. Demo mode runs with no keys.

waitlist.name: Waitlist Launch Kit
waitlist.blurb: A pre-launch landing page with a referral queue, position page, admin dashboard, and CSV export.

status.name: Status Page Kit
status.blurb: A self-hosted status page and uptime monitor with incident posts, 90-day uptime bars, badges, and RSS.

formbox.name: Formbox Kit
formbox.blurb: A self-hosted form backend for static sites: spam filtering, an inbox dashboard, email notifications, webhooks and CSV export. Node + SQLite, demo mode with no keys.

testimonial.name: Testimonial Wall Kit
testimonial.blurb: A self-hosted testimonial collector: submit form, moderation dashboard, Wall of Love page and a one-line embed widget. Node + SQLite, demo mode with no keys.

comments.name: Comments Widget Kit
comments.blurb: Self-hosted comments for static sites and blogs: threaded replies, a moderation dashboard, spam protection, a comment-count script and webhooks. Node + SQLite, demo mode with no keys.

shortlink.name: Short Link Kit
shortlink.blurb: A self-hosted URL shortener with click analytics, QR codes, custom slugs, and link rules, built on Node and SQLite, with a demo mode that needs no keys.

bundle.name: Indie Dev Starter Bundle
bundle.blurb: Five ready-made web kits: TapBlitz, Waitlist Launch Kit, Leaderboard Starter Kit, Tip Jar and Supporter Wall Kit, and Link-in-Bio Pro Kit.
